refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the TAIL tip (proxy z 0.000 at x -0.25..0.0, y 2.1..2.36); the feet hang 0.041 u above it (lowest foot contact = the hind claws, +x (0.396, 0.762, 0.041) / -x (-0.428, 0.663, 0.044)). pulls.why: ARTIST CHANGE 3 ('make its tail longer as well'): the tail = the proxy's central lower-rear plume (midline slab |x| < 0.3: back line y 1.6 -> 2.15 from z 4 down to 1.5, tip (x -0.25..0.0, y 2.25, z 0) in the refloored frame). floor_lift.why: after the refloor to the hind claws the tail tip sits 0.041 u under the floor (sheet_proxy had floored IT): lifted onto z 0 within the bottom 0.3 u, weight 0 in front of y 1.6 so the feet never move
